notes.subject: ol nem bilong animal
notes.rationale: Ol fipela nem long ves dispela — ol man i save tok i no save sori nem bilong wanwan animal; KJV i tok 'ferret, chameleon, lizard, snail, mole', JPS i tok 'gecko, land-crocodile, lizard, sand-lizard, chameleon'.

notes.subject: תנשמת
notes.rationale: Taim we i tok bilong animal long Tanakh, kemilian — wankain nem i kamap long ol pisin nogut (Stat 11:18).

translation: Na geko, na monitor, na liklik dragon we i hait, na skink, na kemilian.

tokens.gloss: na liklik dragon we i hait
